zh: 我昨天扭伤了脚踝，现在肿胀、疼痛，但还能走路。我现在应该如何处理？
en: I sprained my ankle yesterday. It is swollen and painful, but I can still walk. What should I do now?

zh: 脚踝扭伤后出现哪些症状时，我应该去医院或接受X光检查？
en: What symptoms after an ankle sprain mean that I should go to hospital or have an X-ray?

zh: 脚踝扭伤后的康复训练应该按照什么顺序进行？
en: In what order should rehabilitation exercises be performed after an ankle sprain?
expected_heading: 何时以及怎样开始康复训练

zh: 恢复跑步或打篮球之前，我需要达到哪些标准？
en: What criteria should I meet before returning to running or basketball?
expected_heading: 何时恢复走路、跑步或运动

zh: 轻度、中度和重度脚踝扭伤通常有什么区别？
en: What are the usual differences between mild, moderate, and severe ankle sprains?

zh: 脚踝扭伤后什么时候可以开始负重和正常走路？
en: When can I start bearing weight and walking normally after an ankle sprain?
expected_heading: 何时恢复走路、跑步或运动

zh: 脚踝扭伤后的疼痛和肿胀通常需要多久恢复？
en: How long do pain and swelling usually take to recover after an ankle sprain?

zh: 恢复运动后，如何降低脚踝再次扭伤的风险？
en: How can I reduce the risk of another ankle sprain after returning to sport?
expected_heading: 如何恢复稳定性并预防再次扭伤

zh: 恢复篮球运动时，是否应该使用脚踝护具或运动贴扎？
en: Should I use an ankle brace or taping when returning to basketball?
expected_heading: 恢复运动时是否使用护具或贴扎

zh: 脚踝扭伤后应该怎样冷敷和抬高来减轻肿胀？
en: How should I use ice and elevation to reduce swelling after an ankle sprain?
expected_heading: 如何处理肿胀及安全冷敷
